23859-a-venetian-june.title: A Venetian June
23859-a-venetian-june.creator: Anna Fuller and Brian Read
23859-a-venetian-june.description: A book by Anna Fuller and Brian Read. The gondola stirred gently, as with a long, quiet breath, and a moment later it had pushed its way out from among the thronging craft at the steps of the railway quay, and was gliding with its own leisurely motion across the sunlit expanse of the broad Canal.

66918-report-of-the-twentieth-national-a.creator: Unknown

arxiv-2103-10107.title: Danish Fungi 2020 – Not Just Another Image Recognition Dataset
arxiv-2103-10107.creator: Lukáš Picek, Milan Šulc, Jiří Matas, Thomas S. Jeppesen, Jacob Heilmann-Clausen, Thomas Læssøe, Tobias Frøslev
arxiv-2103-10107.description: Abstract We introduce a novel fine-grained dataset and benchmark, the Danish Fungi 2020 (DF20). The dataset, constructed from observations submitted to the Atlas of Danish Fungi, is unique in its taxonomy-accurate class labels, small number of errors, highly unbalanced long-tailed class distribution, rich observation metadata, and well-defined class hierarchy.

arxiv-2208-07842.title: Chiral Gauge Dynamics: Candidates for Non-Supersymmetric Dualities
arxiv-2208-07842.creator: Avner Karasik, Kaan Önder and David Tong
arxiv-2208-07842.description: Abstract We study the dynamics of chiral S ​ U ​ ( N ) SU(N) gauge theories. These contain Weyl fermions in the symmetric or anti-symmetric representation of the gauge group, together with further fermions in the fundamental and anti-fundamental.

arxiv-2212-03278.title: Counterfactual reasoning: Do language models need world knowledge for causal understanding?
arxiv-2212-03278.creator: Jiaxuan Li, Lang Yu, Allyson Ettinger
arxiv-2212-03278.description: Abstract Current pre-trained language models have enabled remarkable improvements in downstream tasks, but it remains difficult to distinguish effects of statistical correlation from more systematic logical reasoning grounded on understanding of the real world. In this paper we tease these factors apart by leveraging counterfactual conditionals , which force language models to predict unusual consequences based on hypothetical propositions.

arxiv-2212-08604.title: Planning Visual-Tactile Precision Grasps via Complementary Use of Vision and Touch
arxiv-2212-08604.creator: Martin Matak, Tucker Hermans
arxiv-2212-08604.description: Abstract Reliably planning fingertip grasps for multi-fingered hands lies as a key challenge for many tasks including tool use, insertion, and dexterous in-hand manipulation. This task becomes even more difficult when the robot lacks an accurate model of the object to be grasped. Tactile sensing offers a promising approach to account for uncertainties in object shape.

arxiv-2307-14224.title: Revealing the Gas Recycling in the Circumgalactic Medium (CGM) Utilizing a Luminous Ly α \alpha nebula around a Type-II Quasar at z = 2.6 z=2.6 with the Keck Cosmic Web Imager (KCWI) Facilities: Keck-II (KCWI) astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , Cloudy ( Ferland et al. 2017 ) , vorbin (
arxiv-2307-14224.creator: Shiwu Zhang, Zheng Cai, Dandan Xu, Andrea Afruni, Yunjing Wu, Wuji Wang, Fabrizio Arrigoni Battaia, Mingyu Li, Sen Wang, Xianzhi Bi
arxiv-2307-14224.description: Abstract How galaxies acquire material from the circumgalactic medium (CGM) is a key question in galaxy evolution. Recent observations and simulations show that gas recycling could be an important avenue for star formation. This paper presents Keck Cosmic Web Imager (KCWI) integral field unit spectroscopic observations on a type-II quasar, Q1517+0055 at z = 2.65 z=2.

arxiv-2307-15072.title: Detecting the Presence of COVID-19 Vaccination Hesitancy from South African Twitter Data Using Machine Learning
arxiv-2307-15072.creator: Nicholas Perikli, Srimoy Bhattacharya, Blessing Ogbuokiri, Zahra Movahedi Nia, Benjamin Lieberman, Nidhi Tripathi, Salah-Eddine Dahbi, Finn Stevenson, Nicola Bragazzi, Jude Kong, Bruce Mellado
arxiv-2307-15072.description: Abstract Abstract Very few social media studies have been done on South African user-generated content during the COVID-19 pandemic and even fewer using hand-labelling over automated methods. Vaccination is a major tool in the fight against the pandemic, but vaccine hesitancy jeopardizes any public health effort.

arxiv-2401-03791.title: Optical Extreme Learning Machines with Atomic Vapors
arxiv-2401-03791.creator: Nuno A. Silva, Vicente Rocha, Tiago D. Ferreira
arxiv-2401-03791.description: Abstract Extreme learning machines explore nonlinear random projections to perform computing tasks on high-dimensional output spaces. Since training only occurs at the output layer, the approach has the potential to speed up the training process and the capacity to turn any physical system into a computing platform.

arxiv-2406-11786.title: A Brief Survey on Leveraging Large Scale Vision Models for Enhanced Robot Grasping
arxiv-2406-11786.creator: Abhi Kamboj, Katie Driggs-Campbell
arxiv-2406-11786.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Abhi Kamboj, Katie Driggs-Campbell. Robotic grasping presents a difficult motor task in real-world scenarios, constituting a major hurdle to the deployment of capable robots across various industries. Notably, the scarcity of data makes grasping particularly challenging for learned models. Recent advancements in computer vision have witnessed a growth of successful unsupervised training mechanisms predicated on massive amounts of data sourced from the internet and now nearly all prominent models leverage pretrained backbone networks.

arxiv-2407-05218.title: Effect of Rotation Angle in Self-Supervised Pre-training is Dataset-Dependent
arxiv-2407-05218.creator: Amy Saranchuk, Michael Guerzhoy
arxiv-2407-05218.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Amy Saranchuk, Michael Guerzhoy. Self-supervised learning for pre-training (SSP) can help the network learn better low-level features, especially when the size of the training set is small. In contrastive pre-training, the network is pre-trained to distinguish between different versions of the input. For example, the network learns to distinguish pairs (original, rotated) of images where the rotated image was rotated by angle θ \theta vs. other pairs of images.

arxiv-2407-10160.title: Spectral Evolution and Photo-ionization Analysis of Nova Cas 2020 (V1391 Cas)
arxiv-2407-10160.creator: G. M. Hamed, H. H. Esenoglu, A. I. Galeev
arxiv-2407-10160.description: Abstract We present spectroscopic observations of Nova Cas 2020(V1391 Cas) obtained using the Russian Turkish Telescope during different stages of its 2020 outburst. We followed the spectral evolution of the nova until it entered the nebular phase. The expansion velocity of the ejecta reached ∼ \sim 780 km ​ s − 1 \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}} .

arxiv-2502-06897.title: PyPotteryInk: One-Step Diffusion Model for Sketch to Publication-ready Archaeological Drawings
arxiv-2502-06897.creator: Lorenzo Cardarelli
arxiv-2502-06897.description: Abstract Archaeological pottery documentation traditionally requires a time-consuming manual process of converting pencil sketches into publication-ready inked drawings. I present PyPotteryInk , an open-source automated pipeline that transforms archaeological pottery sketches into standardised publication-ready drawings using a one-step diffusion model.

arxiv-2510-04429.title: High energy gamma-ray sources in the VVV survey - III. Spectroscopic confirmation of an AGN at low Galactic latitudes 2026 High energy gamma-ray sources in the VVV survey - III. Spectroscopic confirmation of an AGN at low Galactic latitudes – References
arxiv-2510-04429.creator: E. O. Schmidt, L. D. Baravalle, A. Pichel, D. Mast, M. V. Alonso, J. Diaz Tello, L. H. García, V. D. Ivanov, D. Minniti, N. Masetti, L. Donoso, R. Zelada Bacigalupo
arxiv-2510-04429.description: Abstract We aim to spectroscopically confirm the nature of VVV-J181258.71-314346.7, a candidate counterpart to the unassociated gamma-ray source 4FGLJ1812.8-3144. This object was selected based on its near-infrared photometric properties and moderate variability, as part of a broader effort to identify active galactic nuclei (AGN) behind the Galactic bulge and disc.

arxiv-2510-23699.title: Novel black saddles for
arxiv-2510-23699.description: Abstract We construct a series of novel Euclidean multi-black-holes, black ring, black Saturn, and black lens solutions to 5d supergravity that contribute as saddle-points to the 5d gravitational supersymmetric index, either in asymptotically flat space or in asymptotically AdS {}_{3}\times S^{2} .

arxiv-2601-10731.title: Lévy walkers inside spherical shells with absorbing boundaries: Towards settling the optimal Lévy walk strategy for random searches
arxiv-2601-10731.creator: L. G. P. Caramês, Y. B. Matos, F. Bartumeus, C. G. Bezerra, T. Macrì, M. G. E. da Luz, E. P. Raposo, G. M. Viswanathan
arxiv-2601-10731.description: Abstract The Lévy flight foraging hypothesis states that organisms must have evolved adaptations to exploit Lévy walk search strategies. Indeed, it is widely accepted that inverse square Lévy walks optimize the search efficiency in foraging with unrestricted revisits (also known as non-destructive foraging). However, a mathematically rigorous demonstration of this for dimensions D ≥ 2 D\geq 2 is still lacking.

arxiv-2605-30441.creator: Marston Copeland, Ivan Vitev

britannica-1911-augsburg-confession-of.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-augsburg-confession-of.description: Article 'Augsburg, Confession of' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. As he felt free to make slight changes, the first edition does not represent the exact text of 1530; the edition of 1533 was further improved, while that of 1540, rearranged and in part rewritten, is known as the Variata. Dogmatic changes in this seem to have drawn forth no protest from Luther or Brenz, so Melanchthon made fresh alterations in 1542.

pmc-10536281.title: Development and Implementation of a Quadruple RT-qPCR Method for the Identification of Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome Virus Strains
pmc-10536281.creator: Shengnan Ruan, Wenhui Ren, Bin Yu, Xuexiang Yu, Hao Wu, Wentao Li, Yunbo Jiang, Qigai He, Scott P Kenney
pmc-10536281.description: Background: Porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV) causes porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome (PRRS), leading to abortion in sows and respiratory distress in breeding pigs. In China, PRRSV1 and PRRSV2 are the two circulating genotypes in swine herds, with distinct virulence. PRRSV2 further consists of classical (C-PRRSV2), highly pathogenic (HP-PRRSV2), and NADC30-Like (N-PRRSV2) subtypes.

pmc-10772261.title: The predictive and prognostic role of single nucleotide gene variants of PD-1 and PD-L1 in patients with advanced melanoma treated with PD-1 inhibitors
pmc-10772261.creator: A Boutros, R Carosio, D Campanella, F Spagnolo, B Banelli, A Morabito, MP Pistillo, E Croce, F Cecchi, P Pronzato, P Queirolo, E Raposio, V Fontana, ET Tanda
pmc-10772261.description: BackgroundDespite having revolutionized the treatment paradigm for advanced melanoma, not all patients benefit from immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy. To date, there are no predictive biomarkers for response or the occurrence of immune-related adverse events (irAEs) to programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) inhibitors.

pmc-11359216.title: Effects of Environmental Tobacco Smoke on Oxidative Stress in Childhood: A Human Biomonitoring Study
pmc-11359216.creator: Arianna Antonucci, Roberta Andreoli, Chiara Maccari, Matteo Vitali, Carmela Protano, Alexander N Larcombe
pmc-11359216.description: Household smoking is one of the main sources of environmental tobacco smoke (ETS) exposure for children, a population considered to be at high risk for associated negative health outcomes. Several studies evidenced the occurrence of early effects related to ETS exposure, including the development of the oxidative stress process.

pmc-11363723.title: Orienting people-centred disaster shelter planning based on risk assessing with semi-supervised learning
pmc-11363723.creator: Yucheng Zhu, Lu Gan, Xianglong Li, Yufei Zuo, Jiaxin Liu, Benjamin Lev
pmc-11363723.description: Climate-related disasters have been escalating worldwide, incurring major losses. Landslides have become one of the most destructive disasters, especially in China's mountainous areas. To address this, constructing emergency shelters and designing evacuation routes are critical to ensure public safety and minimize impacts on affected residents. This study proposes a novel two-phase, people-centric approach.

pmc-11385789.title: Fibroepithelial polyps causing obstructive hydronephrosis treated with pyeloplasty: A case report
pmc-11385789.creator: Jonathan Alexis Balcazar, Anne Shirley Hoselton, Kyung Park, Dakota Endsley, Parth Shah
pmc-11385789.description: Fibroepithelial polyps (FEP) are rare benign tumors urinary collecting system. Diagnosis is suspected on Computed Tomography (CT) and confirmed via histopathology. Treatment options vary from historic nephroureterectomy to more contemporary methods of ablation. Authors present a case of a symptomatic FEP causing left-sided hydronephrosis and episodic flank pain treated by a urologic surgeon.

pmc-11456230.title: Identification of age-associated microbial changes via long-read 16S sequencing
pmc-11456230.creator: Kai Yee Toh, Tzi Shin Toh, Khi Pin Chua, Priscilla Rajakumar, Jonathan Wei Jie Lee, Chun Wie Chong
pmc-11456230.description: BackgroundAge-related gut microbial changes have been widely investigated over the past decade. Most of the previous age-related microbiome studies were conducted on the Western population, and the short-read sequencing (e.g., 16S V4 or V3-V4 region) was the most common microbiota profiling method. We evaluated the gut compositional differences using the long-read sequencing approach (i.e.

pmc-12659304.title: Prospective video-based analysis of coronal lower limb alignment may be as accurate as radiography in children
pmc-12659304.creator: L. Wystrach, M. Wendt, L. Bode, EJ Kubosch, K. Kuminack, H. Schmal, M. Wenning
pmc-12659304.description: Temporary hemiepiphysiodesis is a growth-guided surgical technique to address lower limb malalignment in children with remaining growth potential. It is a minimally invasive approach that relies on full standing radiography of the lower limb, resulting in exposure to ionizing radiation.

pmc-13102821.title: Clinical development of molecular residual disease (MRD) and multi-cancer early detection (MCED) using liquid biopsy multiomics with artificial intelligence (AI)
pmc-13102821.creator: Taro Shibuki, Riu Yamashita, Tadayoshi Hashimoto, Takao Fujisawa, Mitsuho Imai, Junichiro Yuda, Takeshi Kuwata, Toshihiro Misumi, Yoshiaki Nakamura, Hideaki Bando, Kaname Kojima, Sayuri Tokioka, Ippei Chiba, Naoki Nakaya, Atsushi Hozawa, Seizo Koshiba, Nobuo Fuse, Sakae Saito, Ritsuko Shimizu, Woong
pmc-13102821.description: BackgroundEarly detection of cancer and precise recurrence monitoring remain major unmet needs in oncology. Conventional screening is limited to a few cancer types, leaving nearly half of cancers without established programs. Multi-cancer early detection (MCED) tests based on circulating tumor biomarkers have shown promise, but sensitivity for early-stage remains a challenge.

pmc-13105947.title: Sleeve-fundoplication without gastric resection vs. sleeve gastrectomy: comparable weight loss with reduced GERD incidence in obese rats
pmc-13105947.creator: Minghao Zhang, Jiaqi Hu, Dalin Xu, Yun Wang, Yang Qi, Jun Bu
pmc-13105947.description: IntroductionSleeve gastrectomy (SG) is a first-line bariatric procedure but may exacerbate gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) symptoms in obese patients. To mitigate this critical limitation, we developed a novel sleeve-fundoplication without gastric resection (SG-F) and investigated its efficacy and safety in a rat model of diet-induced obesity.

pmc-13295622.title: Transcriptomic Analysis and Physiological Indicators Synthetically Uncover Candidate Genes Regulating Polyembryony Formation of Phoebe bournei Seeds

pmc-13304775.title: Camptothecin Nanowires Induce the cGAS-STING Pathway to Remold Tumor-Associated Macrophages for Antitumor Immunity
pmc-13304775.creator: Congyi Zhang, Haotian Wu, Xiaotong Chen, Wenze Yin, Shizhuan Huang, Dixiang Wen, Xueting Song, Xiaoyan Xu, Changmei Zhang, Sheng Tai
pmc-13304775.description: Background/Objectives: This study aimed to develop a novel tumor-associated macrophage (TAM)-targeting nanoplatform to improve the solubility and bioavailability of camptothecin (CPT) and achieve active targeted drug delivery for enhanced anti-tumor immunotherapy. Methods: We constructed a sialic acid-disulfide bond-camptothecin (SA-SS-CPT) nanowire system. Sialic acid was used as a targeting ligand to specifically recognize the overexpressed Siglec-E receptor on TAMs.

pmc-13485221.title: The Effects of Dietary Loading on Chondrocytes Transdifferentiation During Postnatal Maxillary Growth
pmc-13485221.creator: Michael Stark, Paria Dehghanian, Ying Liu, LouisBruno Ruest, Matthew J Kesterke, Yan Jing
pmc-13485221.description: BackgroundThe mid‐palatal suture is a key growth site for transverse maxillary expansion, yet the cellular mechanisms governing its postnatal development and response to mechanical loading remain poorly defined.
